name: system-prompt
description: Appends your own instructions to Claude's system context at the start of every session, configured from Claude Code settings.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Inject the configured content. Turn off to keep the settings but stop injecting.

prompt.title: Prompt text
prompt.description: Text appended to Claude's system context. Write \n for a line break.

prompt_file.title: Prompt file
prompt_file.description: Path to a file whose contents are appended after the prompt text. ~ expands to your home; relative paths resolve against the project directory. Several paths can be separated with commas.

every_prompt.title: Repeat on every prompt
every_prompt.description: Also re-inject the content with each message you send, for stronger adherence in long sessions. Costs tokens on every turn.

model_routing.title: Route subagents by task
model_routing.description: Tell Claude to pick the cheapest model that fits each subagent task (haiku for search and reading, sonnet for implementation and review, your own model only for the hardest work).

explore_model.title: Explore subagent model
explore_model.description: Default model for the built-in Explore subagent: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model ID. "off" keeps the built-in. Applies from the next session.

plan_model.title: Plan subagent model
plan_model.description: Default model for the built-in Plan subagent. "off" keeps the built-in. Applies from the next session.

general_model.title: general-purpose subagent model
general_model.description: Default model for the built-in general-purpose subagent. "off" keeps the built-in. Applies from the next session.
